classifier.name: StandardScaler + RBF SVC
classifier.scaler: StandardScaler fit on training rows only

pca_stability.method: class-stratified 80% subsampling without replacement, train only
pca_stability.sampling_strategy: For each of 13 classes, sample 160 of 200 train events without replacement; concatenate and sort indices.
pca_stability.quantile_method: NumPy default linear interpolation over all angles pooled across resamples

limitations: One fixed train/validation split and one classifier random state; metric differences are descriptive, not inferential.
No final test data were accessed.
The PCA20/24 stability follow-up refits PCA on existing train-only resamples; it did not regenerate waveforms.
